exchanges: morning lol its 4am and im already elbow deep in dough
That is an early start. What is on the list today?
croissants, sourdough, the usual. dmitri is late again
Does he usually come in after you?
ya hes not a morning person. funny since he grew up in Odessa where his dad ran a fish stall at dawn
Maybe he used up all his early mornings as a kid.
haha maybe. ok ovens are heating
Good. How many trays this morning?
like 14. my sister amara called last night, shes booked a trip to Marrakech for the spring
That sounds like an amazing trip. Has she been to Morocco before?
no first time. shes so excited she sent me like 30 tiktoks of the souks
Sounds like she is planning well ahead.
and get this, amara our flour rep is ALSO going away, she told me Reykjavik when she dropped off the order
Two people with the same name and two very different climates.
lol right. one gets sun one gets glaciers
Both sound like good trips in their own way.
dmitri just walked in with coffee so hes forgiven
Coffee is a good apology.
i had to make the hazelnut croissants myself tho and my lips are already tingling, im allergic to hazelnuts and i keep forgetting gloves
Please be careful with that. Do you have an antihistamine at the shop?
ya in my bag. its fine its mild
Still, gloves would save you the trouble.
true. ok first customers. keiko came in, shes the student who gets the almond croissant every day
A daily regular is a good sign for the shop.
she told me shes studying architecture at the uni and has a model due friday so shes basically living on our pastries
Pastries and deadlines go well together.
she said her actual fave food is okonomiyaki tho, her grandma makes it
Hard for a croissant to compete with a grandma's cooking.
lol yep. landlord stopped by too
Was it about the lease?
no, tomasz just wanted to show me pics of his new kitten, she's called Kluska, polish for dumpling apparently
That is a sweet name for a kitten.
so cute. ok rush is over. gonna load the van later, my old Subaru is in the shop so we're using dmitri's
Hopefully yours is back on the road soon.
wait no i got it wrong, dmitri grew up in Kharkiv, not odessa. i always mix those two up
Easy mix-up when both cities come up a lot.
anyway Radiohead on full blast in the back, been my fave band since high school and its the only way i survive the dishes
Good soundtrack for a sink full of dishes.
ugh i still have to drive home to Kitsilano after this and the traffic on the bridge is brutal
Is there a better time to leave?
after 2 its ok i guess. ok cleaning up
Nearly done for the day then.
my nephew kofi is coming by after school, hes started cello lessons and wants to play for us lol
A live concert in the bakery, nice.
wait where did my sister say she was going again
ok kofi is here with his cello case thats bigger than him
That is a lot of instrument for a kid.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your sister Amara is going to Marrakech in the spring.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your sister Amara is going to Reykjavik.
